title: Wake the dormant governance test suite and pin the task-manifest status vocabulary
goal: Stop a whole class of silent drift: 13 of the 28 test files under tests/scripts/ had no npm script and 12 of the 17 test: scripts were referenced by no workflow, so the repository's own governance regression tests ran nowhere. Running them for the first time exposed two real failures (one of them caused by an earlier un-gated strict-mode change in check-boundaries.mjs), so fix those, wire the suite into CI behind a catch-all script, and close the adjacent gap where manifest.json `status` was free text with three vocabularies in use (completed 101 / done 7 / complete 2) that no gate validated.
statusNote: 2026-09-23: tests/scripts/ now runs 124/124 green, up from 123 tests with 2 failures once the suite was actually executed. The two failures were a stale branch-hygiene assertion (the push-to-main trigger was deliberately removed in #142 and the test was never updated because nothing ran it) and a check-boundaries test still asserting the pre-2026-09-23 lenient behaviour for stale baseline entries, which the same round had tightened. Wiring is via a new `test:scripts` catch-all (`node --test tests/scripts/*.test.mjs`) invoked from the ci.yml 'Run npm script tests' step, guarded by an assertion in ci-workflow-dispatch.test.mjs so the wiring itself cannot silently disappear. The manifest status rule is validated in scripts/task-manifest.mjs and reaches every manifest because check-visual-evidence.mjs (wired as check:harness-visual) iterates listTaskManifestPaths; all 110 manifests were normalised to `completed`.
technicalDebtNote: Three related gaps stay open by decision rather than being fixed here: check-evidence.mjs and check-review.mjs are listed by check-method-health.mjs as expected harness scripts but are executed by nothing and are fully red against the legacy artifacts (196 and 51 errors over 93/98 files); check-graph-review.mjs is likewise unwired and reports pre-existing subgraph mismatches for the tenant packets; and pantheon-ops carries 15 manifests with no `status` plus 10 non-canonical values which the inherited schema will reject at sync time.
dependencyLayers: tests/scripts governance regression suite and the CI npm script step
scripts/task-manifest.mjs schema and the gates that read every manifest
